By way of present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.0036/2022 registered under Sections 498A/406/376/377/345A/34 of IPC at P.S. Samaipur Badli, Delhi and proceedings emanating therefrom.
2.

The present FIR arises out of a matrimonial dispute between the complainant/respondent No. 2 wife and her husband (brother of petitioner Nos. 1, 4 and 5 and son of petitioner Nos. 2 and 3)
whereas petitioner Nos. 1 to 5 are the in-laws of the complainant.
3. Learned APP for the state submits that in the present case, the petitioners are the accused persons and the complainant/respondent No.2 is the victim.

sentences.text: Respondent No.2 appears through VC and is identified by her counsel as well as by the IO/ SI Sachin PS Samaipur Badli, Delhi.

She submits that she has already reached an amicable settlement with her husband and petitioner Nos.2 to 5, who are the parents-in-law, sister-in-law and brother- in-law of the complainant, respectively.

She further submits that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR against these petitioners, i.e., qua petitioner Nos. 2 to 5.
6.
The petitioners, who are present in Court, are identified by their counsel.

Learned counsel for the petitioners reiterates that petitioner Nos.2 to 5 have reached an amicable settlement with respondent No.2/complainant, however, on instructions from petitioner No.1, she insists on arguing on merits insofar as petitioner No.1 is concerned, without prejudice to his rights and contentions.

7. Considering the no objection given by respondent No.2, and in view of the above facts and since no useful purpose will be served in continuance of the present criminal proceedings, it is directed that the aforesaid FIR and the consequent proceedings arising therefrom are hereby quashed qua petitioner Nos. 2 to 5.
8.

Insofar as quashing of the FIR qua petitioner No.1 is concerned, list for consideration on 05.03.2025.
9.
In the meantime, let amended memo of parties be filed.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J NOVEMBER 7, 2024/rd
